5051001.desc: When used, #call skills except for Beginner, Hyper, 5th, and 6th Job Advancement skills# #cwill be reset#.\r\n\r\n- For #cZero#, #call skills except common, transcendents, 5th, and 6th Job Advancement skills# #cwill be reset#.

5060000.name: Item Tag
5060000.desc:
Engraves the owner's name on a piece of equipment. #cDrag the item icon on to the equipment piece of your choice# to engrave your character's name on it. 
Cannot be used on previously engraved equipment.
If used on an item with a crafter's name attached, #cthe crafter's name will be overwritten with the newest name#. 
Cannot be used on Zero weapons.

5060001.name: Item Guard
5060001.desc: Double-click the lock and drag an item into the slot to prevent non-quest, non-locked items from being #cvendor traded, exchanged, dropped, scrolled, or used by certain cash items#.

5060002.name: Incubator
5060002.desc: An equipment needed to open the #ceggs from pigme#.  Pigme eggs canve incubated by double clicking the incubator.

5060003.name: Peanut Machine
5060003.desc: An odd-looking contraption that cracks #cPeanuts#. Double-click the Peanut Machine to use it.

5060004.name: Microwave
5060004.desc: A device used to melt #cIce Cubes#. Double-click the microwave to use it.

5060005.name: Incubator
5060005.desc: A device needed to #chatch a Pygmy Egg#. You can hatch a Pygmy Egg by double clicking on the Incubator. The Incubator will give you a better chance of obtaining valuable items.

5060006.name: Magic Music Box
5060006.desc: A jeweled music box that once belonged to a legendary hero of the past. Can be opened with a #cHero's Key#, dropped by monsters and sold at Elluel General Store. Use by double-clicking on the music box.

5060007.name: Crystal Scale
5060007.desc: An enchanted crystalline sale. Acquire a Renegades Gem from defeated monsters and place it on the scale to obtain a special item.

5060008.name: Magical Teapot
5060008.desc: A magical tea pot. Add #cEnchanted Teabags#, dropped by monsters, or brew up special items. Double click on the tea pot to add teabags!

5060010.name: Item Tag Clear
5060010.desc: You can erase the name engraved on equipment with the Item Tag item. #cDrag and drop this item onto the equipment you want to erase the name from.# \nCannot be used on Zero's weapon.

5060012.name: Mermaid Mirror
5060012.desc: A fancy hand mirror frame, missing the mirror glass. Find #cClear Mirror Glass# on monsters or purchase it from any General Store, and then place it on the frame to obtain a special item. Double-click on the Mermaid Mirror to place the glass.

5060013.name: Emerald Mirror
5060013.desc: An amazing mirror which contains a few #cpopular equipment items and rare scrolls#. If you double-click on the Emerald Mirror, you can place #cEmerald Mirror Glass# on it to obtain a special item. You can get #cEmerald Mirror Glass# either from monster drops or by buying it at General Stores.

5060014.name: Spinel's Mirror
5060014.desc: A magical mirror that contains a marvelous assortment of #cchairs and Jag Jump Riding items#. If you double-click on the Spinel's Mirror, you can place #cSpinel's Mirror Glass# in it, which you can purchase from General Stores, to obtain a special item.

5060016.name: Magical Book
5060016.desc: Open this magical book to acquire #cpopular equipment, rare scrolls, and other rare items#. Double-click to open the book, or use a #cMagical Quill Pen# from the General Store.

5060017.name: Philosopher's Book
5060017.desc: #cDouble-click# to use and obtain#c 2 of a number of possible rare items.# The 2 items will be selected from different reward pools.

5060018.name: Infinity Book
5060018.desc: Open this Infinity Book to acquire #cone of several surprising items#. Combine with an #cInfinity Quill Pen#, available at the General Store or dropped by monsters, to open.

5060019.name: Stone Seal Breaker
5060019.desc: This Stone Seal Breaker can open the Magi-Stone Box, revealing #cone of several rare items#.  You can acquire a #cMagi-Stone Box# via quests or by hunting monsters.

5060022.name: Fairy Vial
5060022.desc: Fill with Fairy Tears to gain one rare item. Double-click on the Fairy Vial to open the item window and drop in Fairy Tears. Fairy Tears can be acquired from monsters or from General Store in town.

5060023.name: Chaos Purification Stone
5060023.desc: Combine this Chaos Purification Stone with the Chaos Box to acquire #cone of several rare items#. You can acquire a #cChaos Box# via quests or by hunting monsters.

5060024.name: Cryptic Stone
5060024.desc: Combine with the Cryptic Chest to acquire #cone of many amazing items#!

5060025.name: Magic Harp
5060025.desc: Place a Magic Note in this Magic Harp to get #cone rare item#. This also fills the harp with a little bit of magic. When the harp is completely filled with magic, Fever Time starts! During Fever Time, your chances of obtaining the special item of the month significantly increases! To use, #cdouble-click# the harp and place a #cMagic Note# int he window that appears. You can get Magic Notes from hunting monsters or from General Stores in towns.

5060026.name: Miracle Stone
5060026.desc: Place a Miracle Stone into the Ancient Chest to get #cone random item#. You can find Ancient Chests while hunting monsters.

5060027.name: Emerald Harp
5060027.desc: #cDouble-click# on this harp, then drop an #cEnchanting Melody# in the window to unlock #cone rare item#. Each melody will fill the harp with a little bit of magic, and when it's full, Fever Time will begin! During Fever Time, you'll have a much better chance of unlocking the item of the month.

5060028.name: Tommelise's Box
5060028.desc: Use Pandora's Key on Pandora's Box to unlock #cone rare item#. Every time you open Pandora's Box, you gain some magical power. Item Fever will trigger with enough power, #cgreatly increasing your chances to obtain special items#. Double-click Pandora's Box to use. You can get Pandora's Key from monsters or at the General Store.

5060029.name: Andersen's Box
5060029.desc: You can get#c one random item# from Andersen's Box. #cDouble-click# to use.

5060032.name: Andersen's Box
5060032.desc: Use Andersen's Key to get one random item from Andersen's Box. You can get Andersen's Key by hunting monsters or from General Stores in towns.

5060046.name: Andersen's Chair Box
5060046.desc: Use Andersen's Chair Key to get one random chair from Andersen's Chair Box. You can get Andersen's Chair Key by hunting monsters or from General Stores in towns.

5060047.name: Andersen's Mount Box
5060047.desc: Use Andersen's Mount Key to get one random mount from Andersen's Mount Box. You can get Andersen's Mount Key by hunting monsters or from General Stores in towns.

5060048.name: Golden Apple
5060048.desc: It's glimmering with power! #cDouble-click# to get an item and a Golden Apple Slice.#\r\n\r\n* Not usable between HH:MM AM/PM - HH:MM AM/PM UTC on the 1st of every month.
5060048.desc_leftalign: #c- 획득 가능한 아이템 및 확률 정보는 홈페이지>가이드>확률형 아이템 페이지에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.#

5060089.name: 플래티넘 애플
5060089.desc: #c더블클릭#하여 사용하면 신의 열매 플래티넘 애플이 신비의 힘을 발휘하여 #c아이템 1개#를 획득할 수 있다.\n#c플래티넘 애플의 목록은 정해진 기간마다 교체될 수 있다.
5060089.desc_leftalign: #c- 획득 가능한 아이템 및 확률 정보는 홈페이지>가이드>확률형 아이템 페이지에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.#

5060092.name: Grand Collection
5060092.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain #c1 item# according to set probability rates.\n#cThe Grand Collection item list is subject to change at set intervals.
5060092.desc_leftalign: #c- The list of obtainable items and rates can be viewed from the official website > Game > Random Box Rates page.#

5060093.name: Mystic Collection
5060093.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain #c1 item# according to set probability rates.\n#cThe Mystic Collection item list is subject to change at set intervals.
5060093.desc_leftalign: #c- The list of obtainable items and rates can be viewed from the official website > Game > Random Box Rates page.#

5060094.name: Boutique Gift
5060094.desc:
#cDouble-click# to obtain a Boutique Ticket that can be exchanged for a special item.

Upon use, obtain #cx1-10, x50, x100, x500, or x1000# tickets based on a set probability.

Every #c10 uses#, #cFever Time# will activate and grant you #c10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 100, 200, 1000, or 2000# tickets.

#cThe items that can be exchanged for tickets change after a set period.#
5060094.desc_leftalign: #c- The list of obtainable items and rates can be viewed from the official website > Game > Random Box Rates page.#

5061000.name: Item Guard : 7 Days
5061000.desc: Double-click the lock and choose a non-quest, non-locked item to prevent it from being #cvendor traded, exchanged, dropped, scrolled, or used by certain cash items#. #cItems cannot be unsealed for 7 days.# * You cannot delete a character that is currently using an Item Guard. Soul Weapons and Soul Gems cannot be used on a locked item.

5061001.name: Item Guard : 30 Days
5061001.desc: Double-click the lock and choose a non-quest, non-locked item to prevent it from being #cvendor traded, exchanged, dropped, scrolled, or used by certain cash items#. #cItems cannot be unsealed for 30 days.# * You cannot delete a character that is currently using an Item Guard. Soul Weapons and Soul Gems cannot be used on a locked item.

5061002.name: Item Guard : 90 days
5061002.desc: Double-click the lock and choose a non-quest, non-locked item to prevent it from being #cvendor traded, exchanged, dropped, scrolled, or used by certain cash items#. #cItems cannot be unsealed for 90 days.# * You cannot delete a character that is currently using an Item Guard. Soul Weapons and Soul Gems cannot be used on a locked item.

5061003.name: Item Guard : 365 Days
5061003.desc: Double-click the lock and choose a non-quest, non-locked item to prevent it from being #cvendor traded, exchanged, dropped, scrolled, or used by certain cash items#. #cItems cannot be unsealed for 365 days.# * You cannot delete a character that is currently using an Item Guard. Soul Weapons and Soul Gems cannot be used on a locked item.

5062000.name: Miracle Cube
5062000.desc: A mysterious cube, said to bring out the hidden potential of equipment. \n#cOnly usable on items graded Rare to Unique# \n#cMax Result: Unique#

5062002.name: Super Miracle Cube
5062002.desc: A mysterious cube, said to bring out the hidden potential of equipment. Has a greater chance of raising equipment rank than the Miracle Cube. \n#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary#\n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062005.name: Enlightening Miracle Cube
5062005.desc: An #camazing# cube that resets equipment potential and has a chance to upgrade all potentials to the #chighest available grade#.\n#cOnly usable on items grades Rare to Legendary# \n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062006.name: Platinum Miracle Cube
5062006.desc: An extremely powerful cube used to reset existing Potentials on your equipment. This cube has a greater chance to increase an item's rank than other Miracle Cubes, and it can #cupgrade all current Potentials to their highest possible values#. \n#cOnly works on items rank Rare to Legendary. # \n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062009.name: Red Cube
5062009.desc:
A beautifully crafted cube that
 randomly reconfigures the
Potential on a piece of 
equipment. 
#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary.# 
#cMax Result: Legendary #

5062010.name: Black Cube
5062010.desc: An elegant cube that randomly configures the Potential on a piece of equipment. The Black Cube offers you the chance to decide whether or not to #capply the new Potential to your item#. However, it does not influence Bonus Potentials. \n#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary.# \n#cMax Result: Legendary# Black Cubes have a higher chance to raise your Potential rank than Red Cubes do.

5062090.name: Memory Cube
5062090.desc: A cube of great wisdom. This cube allows the user to #cdecide if they want to accept the resulting Potential reset before it is completed#. Does not affect Bonus Potentials.\n#cOnly works on items rank Rare to Legendary. # \n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062100.name: 8th Anniversary Miracle Cube
5062100.desc: A miracle cube that can only be used on Maple 8th Anniversary Crimson equipment. It can reveal higher potentials than normal miracle cubes.

5062103.name: Octacular Miracle Cube
5062103.desc:
A miracle cube that can only be used on 8th Maple Anniversary equipment. 
It reveals higher potentials than normal miracle cubes.
#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary#
#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062200.name: Inner Ability B-Rank Lock
5062200.desc: Maintains #cRank B# Inner Abilities when reconfiguring with a Circulator. \n#cDouble click# to protect the #cRank# of one Inner Ability that is currently Rank B. \nThe Rank protection effect will disappear after one #creconfiguration# with the Circulator.

5062201.name: Inner Ability A-Rank Lock
5062201.desc: Maintains #cRank A# Inner Abilities when reconfiguring with a Circulator. \n#cDouble click# to protect the #cRank# of one Inner Ability that is currently Rank A. \nThe Rank protection effect will disappear after one #creconfiguration# with the Circulator.

5062400.name: Fusion Anvil
5062400.desc: Allows you to take the #cstats and bonuses from one item (same gender)# and combine them with the #cappearance of another#. The effect is decided by the appearance item. There is a risk that items with similar appearances may be fused together! \nAvailable Equipment: Hats, eye accessories, face accessories, tops, bottoms, outfits, shoes, gloves, capes, weapons, shields, and kataras for a total of 12 types.\r\n#c* Warning: Cannot use Zero weapons, and using Zero equipment will be based on Alpha's character.#

5062402.name: Medal Fusion Anvil
5062402.desc: Allows you to change the look of a #cMedal# while keeping its stats by fusing it with another medal. The effect is decided by the appearance item. Beware! Items with a similar appearance may be fused together! Available Equipment: Medal

5062403.name: [Special] Medal Fusion Anvil
5062403.desc: Allows you to take the #cstats and bonuses from one item (same gender)# and combine them with the #cappearance of another#. The effect is decided by the appearance item. There is a risk that items with similar appearances may be fused together! \nAvailable Equipment: Hats, eye accessories, face accessories, tops, bottoms, outfits, shoes, gloves, capes, weapons, shields, and kataras for a total of 12 types.\r\n#c* Warning: Cannot use Zero weapons, and using Zero equipment will be based on Alpha's character.#

5062405.name: Fusion Anvil
5062405.desc: Allows you to take the #cstats and bonuses from one item (same gender)# and combine them with the #cappearance of another#. The effect is decided by the appearance item. There is a risk that items with similar appearances may be fused together! \nAvailable Equipment: Hats, eye accessories, face accessories, tops, bottoms, outfits, shoes, gloves, capes, weapons, shields, and kataras for a total of 12 types.\r\n#c* Warning: Cannot use Zero weapons, and using Zero equipment will be based on Alpha's character.#

5062406.name: Luna Illusion
5062406.desc: A #cLuna Illusion# containing pure lunar energy. Double-click to use on a #cPetite/Dream Luna Pet# to change the appearance of the pet to #cmatch that of a chosen fusion material pet.#. Can be used #c1 time#.
5062406.desc_leftalign:
#c[Notes]#
- The fusion material pet will #cdisappear# after transferring its appearance.
- For Interactive Worlds, the #ctradability of the base pet remains the same# after the transfer.
- Even if a pet had its color changed with a Pet Dye Coupon, the resulting pet will appear as its #cbase appearance before the dye was applied#.
- #cThe types of pet equipment the pet can use doesn't change# after transferring.
- If the pet and the visual aspects of their equipped pet equipment aren't compatible, the pet equipment won't show in the field, but #cthe equipment's Bonus Stats will still apply#.

#c[Use Conditions]#
#c- Base Pet:# Petite/Dream Luna Pet (excluding pets that can't have their Magic Duration extended.)
#c- Material Pet:# All pets (excluding other Petite Luna ranked pets).

#c[Affected Aspects]#
- Pet appearance, pet speech bubble/label appearance, pet dialogue, and pet commands.

5062407.name: Aurora Illusion
5062407.desc: An #cAurora Illusion# containing pure auroral energy. Double-click to use on #cpet equipment that can be equipped by a Petite/Dream Luna Pet# to change the appearance of the equipment to #cmatch that of a chosen piece of fusion material pet equipment#. Can be used #c1 time#.
5062407.desc_leftalign:
#c[Notes]#
- The fusion material pet equipment will #cdisappear# after transferring its appearance.
- For Interactive Worlds, the #ctradability of the pet equipment remains the same# after the transfer.
- Even if a piece of pet equipment had its appearance changed, the #ctypes of pet equipment a pet can equip doesn't change.#
- If the pet and the visual aspects of their equipped pet equipment aren't compatible, the pet equipment won't show in the field, but #cfor Interactive Worlds, the equipment's Bonus Stats will still apply#.

#c[Use Conditions]#
#c- Base Pet Equipment:# Equipment equippable by Petite/Dream Luna pets.
#c- Material Pet Equipment:# All pet equipment (excluding equipment that can be equipped by Petite Luna pets).

5062408.name: Illusion Restore
5062408.desc: An #cIllusion Restore# that can nullify the effects of lunar and auroral energy.\nDouble-click to use on a #cpet or pet equipment that had a Luna or Aurora Illusion used on them# to #crevert the pet or pet equipment to its original appearance#. Can be used #c1 time#.\nEven if the pet or the pet equipment's appearance changes, the #ctypes of pet equipment a pet can equip doesn't change#. If the pet and the visual aspects of their equipped pet equipment aren't compatible, the pet equipment won't show in the field, but #cfor Interactive Worlds, the equipment's Bonus Stats will still apply#.

5062500.name: Bonus Potential Cube
5062500.desc: A powerful cube that reconfigures a piece of equipment's Bonus Potential. Does not affect existing regular Potentials. \n#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary#\n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062501.name: [Special] Bonus Potential Cube
5062501.desc: A powerful cube that reconfigures a piece of equipment's Bonus Potential. Does not affect existing regular Potentials. \n#cOnly usable on items from Rare to Legendary#\n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062503.name: Bonus Bright Cube
5062503.desc: This cube allows the user to #cdecide if they want to accept the resulting Bonus Potential reset before it is completed#. Does not affect Potentials.\n#cOnly works on items with Rare to Legendary bonus potential. # \n#cMax Result: Legendary#

5062800.name: Miracle Circulator
5062800.desc: #cDouble-click# on this item to reset your character's Inner Ability. Does not apply to locked ranks or stats. Upon use, the Ability rank and the rank of the first line will either increase or remain the same. The ranks of the second and last lines will be randomized.\n#cOnly works on Epic Ability rank or higher \nMaximum final result: Legendary#

5062801.name: Miracle Circulator
5062801.desc: #cDouble-click# on this item to reset your character's Inner Ability. Does not apply to locked ranks or stats. Upon use, the Ability rank and the rank of the first line will either increase or remain the same. The ranks of the second and last lines will be randomized.\n#cOnly works on Epic Ability rank or higher \nMaximum final result: Legendary#

5063000.name: Luck's Key
5063000.desc: Feeling lucky? Increases the success rate of the next scroll use by 10%.
5063000.autodesc: \r\n#cIncreases the success rate of your next scroll.\r\n#

5063100.name: Lucky Shielding Ward
5063100.desc: Increases the chance of success for the next scroll used by #c10%# and #cprotects the item from vanishing#. \nThe ward's effect will be consumed even after a successful scroll usage. Cannot be used with items that already have Shielding Ward or Lucky Day Scrolls applied. Cannot be used with #cEnhancement Scrolls#.
5063100.autodesc: \r\n#cIncreases the success rate of your next scroll, and safeguards your item against vanishing 1 time.\r\n#

5064000.name: Shielding Ward
5064000.desc:
A Shielding Ward that #cprotects a piece of equipment from vanishing# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.
The Shielding Ward effect will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll with a destruction chance.

<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scrolls
- Fully enhanced equipment
- Equipment successfully enhanced 12 or more times
- Superior equipment
- Pet equipment
5064000.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shield Scrolls, Guardian Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.

5064002.name: Shielding Ward Lite
5064002.desc:
A Shielding Ward that #cprotects a piece of equipment level 105 or below from vanishing# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.
The Shielding Ward will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll with a destruction chance.

<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scrolls
- Fully enhanced equipment
- Equipment successfully enhanced 12 or more times
- Superior equipment
- Pet equipment
5064002.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shield Scrolls, Guardian Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.

5064003.name: Superior Shielding Ward
5064003.desc:
A Shielding Ward that #cprotects a piece of superior equipment from vanishing# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.
The Shielding Ward will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll with a destruction chance.

<Unusable Items>
- Fully enhanced equipment
- Equipment successfully enhanced 7 or more times
5064003.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shield Scrolls, Guardian Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.

5064004.name: [MS Discount] Shielding Ward
5064004.desc:
A Shielding Ward that #cprotects a piece of equipment from vanishing# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.
The Shielding Ward effect will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll with a destruction chance.

<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scrolls
- Fully enhanced equipment
- Equipment successfully enhanced 12 or more times
- Superior equipment
- Pet equipment
5064004.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shield Scrolls, Guardian Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.

5064100.name: Shield Scroll
5064100.desc: A Shield Scroll that protects a piece of equipment from #chaving its remaining scroll count reduced# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.\nThe Shield Scroll will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll that reduces the remaining scroll count.
5064100.autodesc: \r\n#cSafeguards your item against upgrade count loss 1 time.\r\n#
5064100.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shielding Wards and Guardian Scrolls.\n#cCannot be used with Return Scrolls.

5064101.name: Shield Scroll Lite
5064101.desc: A Shield Scroll that protects a piece of equipment #clevel 105 or below# from #chaving its remaining scroll count reduced# by a failed scroll #c1 time# when used on it.\nThe Shield Scroll will disappear even after a successful use of a scroll that reduces the remaining scroll count.
5064101.autodesc: \r\n#cSafeguards your item against upgrade count loss 1 time.\r\n#
5064101.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shielding Wards and Guardian Scrolls.\n#cCannot be used with Return Scrolls.

5064200.name: Perfect Innocence Scroll
5064200.desc: #cResets# all stats on an item, except for Hidden Potentials. Can only be used on equipment. If used on an item that grows, the item may revert to its pre-growth state. \nCannot be used on items that have #cScissors of Karma, Sharing Tag, Item Guard# applied. Additional stats will not be reset.
5064200.autodesc: \r\n#cResets all stats to their original values (Potential excluded)\r\n#

5064201.name: Innocence Scroll Lite
5064201.desc: #cResets# all stats on an item, except for Hidden Potentials. Can only be used on equipment #clevels 105 and below#. If used on an item that grows, the item may revert to its pre-growth state. \nCannot be used on items that have #cScissors of Karma, Sharing Tag, Item Guard# applied. Additional stats will not be reset.
5064201.autodesc: \r\n#cResets all stats to their original values (Potential excluded)\r\n#

5064300.name: Guardian Scroll
5064300.desc:
A Guardian Scroll that will #cpreserve a scroll# if its use fails #c1 time# when used on equipment.
The Guardian Scroll will disappear even after a successful scroll use.

<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scrolls
- Equipment with no remaining scroll count
- Pet equipment with no scroll uses remaining
5064300.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shielding Wards, Shield Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.\n#cCannot be used with Karma Bonus Epic Potential Scrolls.

5064301.name: Guardian Scroll Lite
5064301.desc:
A Guardian Scroll that will #cpreserve a scroll# if its use fails #c1 time# when used on #clevel 105 or below# equipment.
The Guardian Scroll effect will disappear even after a successful scroll use.

<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scrolls
- Equipment with no remaining scroll count
- Pet equipment with no scroll uses remaining
5064301.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shielding Wards, Shield Scrolls, and Return Scrolls.\n#cCannot be used with Karma Bonus Epic Potential Scrolls.

5064400.name: Return Scroll
5064400.desc:
A Return Scroll that #cgives you the choice of keeping the old stats or accepting the stat changes the next time a scroll that changes non-potential stats# is used on a piece of equipment #c1 time#.
The Return Scroll effect disappears even after a failed use of a scroll that reduces the remaining scroll count and the remaining scroll count is kept.

#<Unusable Items>
- Equipment that uses only exclusive enhancement scroll
- Equipment given during tutorial
- Pet equipment
- Zero weapons
5064400.autodesc: \r\n#cAllows you to choose between the before and after effects of a scroll upon using it.\r\n#
5064400.desc_leftalign: Can be used along with Shielding Wards and Guardian Scrolls.\n#cCannot be used with Safety Shield.

5064600.name: Bonus Stats Transfer Scroll
5064600.desc:
Transfers an item's bonus stats to #canother item of the same name#.
#cThe first item will disappear upon having its bonus stats transferred to the second item.#
Items that do not have the #cScissors Usages Available stat# will be set to 10 uses, except for specific items.

Cannot be used on the following items:
#c - Items without bonus stats
 - Items that had bonus stats transferred
 - Heavy Swords and Long Swords
 - Equipment Trace
 - Untradeable items that cannot use scissors or with a remaining scissor count of 0
 - Items that are Mementos or that have a Mark of Binding
 - Items that disappear when you log out
- Items with a Green PC exclusive lock feature
 - Certain items that cannot be enhanced
5064600.desc_leftalign:
#cCannot be used on the following items:
- Items that can be traded
- Items without bonus stats
 - Heavy Swords and Long Swords
 - Equipment Trace
- Items that have a Mark of Binding
- Items that disappear when you log out
- Items with a Green PC exclusive lock feature
 - Certain items that cannot be enhanced

5064610.name: Potential Transfer Scroll
5064610.desc:
#cTransfers# the potential of a piece of #cLegendary equipment# to another piece of equipment with #cthe same name#.
#cBonus Potential is not transferred.
The first item will disappear upon having its potential transferred to the second item.#

Cannot be used on the following items:
#c - Items without potential and items that are lower than Legendary Grade
 - Items that had potential transferred
 - Heavy Swords and Long Swords
 - Secondary Weapons, Kataras, and Shields
 - Equipment Trace
 - Untradeable items that cannot use scissors or remaining scissors count is 0
 - Items that are Mementos or that have a Mark of Binding
 - Items that disappear when you log out
- Items with a Green PC exclusive lock feature
 - Certain items that cannot be enhanced
5064610.desc_leftalign:
#cCannot be used on the following items:
- Items that can be traded
- Items without bonus stats or items that are lower than Legendary Grade
 - Heavy Swords and Long Swords
 - Secondary Weapons, Kataras, and Shields
 - Equipment Trace
- Items that have a Mark of Binding
- Items that disappear when you log out

5170000.name: Pet Name Tag
5170000.desc: Use this item to name your pet. If you call its name before making an order, your pet will respond much better to your command. \n ex. Lucky, sit! \r\nOnly #cletters and numbers# can be used in names, and #conly 1 blank space is allowed in the text of the name.#

5180000.desc: Mysterious water collected from a deep well beneath Ellinia. Take it to Fairy Mar in Ellinia to grant #c90 days# of magic duration to your pet. (Can be extended only up to 365 days while the magic duration remains.)\nDoes not work on #cMiracle Pets#.

5190000.name: Item Pouch Skill
5190000.desc: Adds the Item Pouch skill to the selected pet.\n#cCan only be used on pets with Meso Magnet.

5190001.name: Auto HP Potion Skill
5190001.desc: Allows your pet to use HP potions on you when you're hurting. \n#cAvailable to all pets that do not have this skill.#

5190002.desc: This scroll expands the pet's auto move by 3x.\n#cCan only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill. Cannot be stacked for use.\nCannot add this skill to Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

5190003.name: Auto Move Skill
5190003.desc: Adds a skill that automatically picks up nearby items and mesos without having to move.\n#cCan be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.

5190004.name: Expired Pickup Skill
5190004.desc: Allows your pet to pick up items left by other players. It takes 110 seconds for an item to be released from ownership so your pet can take it.\n#cAvailable to pets with meso and item pick-up skills.#

5190005.name: Ignore Item Skill
5190005.desc: A skill to prevent pets from collecting selected items. Equipping a pet with this skill will apply the skill to#c all equipped pets.# You can use this on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch. Some items, including quest and untradable, cannot be selected.

5190006.name: Auto MP Potion Skill
5190006.desc: Allows your pet to use MP potions on you when you're running dry. \n#cAvailable to all pets that do not have this skill.#

5190010.name: Auto Buff Skill
5190010.desc: Choose one buff skill you want from the Skill window and drag it to the bottom of the Pet Equip tab. Once it's saved, the pet will use the chosen skill automatically. You can save up to 2 skills per pet. Cannot be used on certain skills, #cincluding hyper skills#.

5190011.name: Auto Feed and Movement Skill
5190011.desc: Allows your pet to feed itself using Pet Food from your inventory. Also allows your pet to navigate multi-level maps to pick up mesos and items if it has the #cAuto Move Skill#. \n#cCan be used on all pets.#

5190012.name: Fatten Up Skill
5190012.desc: Hunting enemies near your level will cause your pet to grow. Once it grows large enough, it will cast a mysterious buff. Once the buff goes into effect, you'll have to hit an enemy at least 5 minutes later to trigger the buff again.\n#cCannot be used on Action Pets.#

5190013.name: Open Pet Shop Skill
5190013.desc: Add an Open General Store skill to the designated pet. You can purchase potions to recover HP & MP, or get throwing stars and bullets. Some maps restrict the use of this item, though.

5190014.name: Slimming Medicine
5190014.desc: Giving this medicine to a pet with the #cFatten Up# skill will remove the Fatten Up skill.

5191000.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet will no longer pick up items.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

5191001.desc: Use this scroll to disable the pet from automatically feeding the character when the HP reaches critical stage.

5191002.name: (-)Delete Expand Range
5191002.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet's range of travel will return to the default.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

5191003.name: (-) Delete Automatic Pick-Up
5191003.desc: If you use this scroll, your pet will no longer automatically move to pick up items and mesos.\n#cCannot be used on Petite pets born from Luna Crystals.#

5191004.desc: Use this scroll to disable pets from picking up leftover items and mesos, the ones that have been dropped for more than 30 seconds.
